notes: Template: TBox contraction, paired with history-replace-0006. Removes the revision's original fact (every Roman aqueduct moved its water by gravity alone). The derived queries name three obscure aqueducts as Roman aqueducts and ask how they moved their water, an open question. The paraphrase and cross-lingual questions are the revision's gravity-or-pumps choices, which the audit found answerable. The negation is worded 'Is it true that ... did not ...?'. Near, far and side facts are the revision's. Inverted siphons still run on the head of water, so there is no exception.
